For Petitioner : Mr.K.Sundaravel  For Respondent : Mr..T.Senthil Kumar  Additional Public Prosec  ORDER [Order of the Court was made by G.K.ILANTHIRAIYAN, J.]

This criminal miscellaneous petition has been filed seeking to suspend the sentence imposed on the petitioner by the Principal Special Court for POCSO Act cases, Theni, in Special S.C.No.280 of 2023, dated 09/12/2024 and to enlarge the petitioner on bail pending disposal of the criminal appeal.

entities.text: Principal Special Court for POCSO Act cases, Theni
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2.The petitioner stands convicted and sentenced as under:-
Sentence of Section of Law Fine amount imprisonment Rs.5,000/-, in default to 6 of POCSO Act Life Imprisonment undergo 2 years RI Rs.50,000/-, in default to 376(AB) of IPC Life Imprisonment undergo 2 years RI
3.Heard the learned counsel on either side and perused the materials available on record.
_ __ https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis

( Uploaded on: 19/01/2026 08:24:37 pm )
4.The petitioner has failed to make out a prima facie case for grant of suspension of sentence, hence we are of the opinion that it is not a fit case for grant of suspension of sentence to the petitioner.
5.Accordingly this Criminal Miscellaneous Petition stands dismissed.
Post the main appeal on 27/01/2026 under the caption for orders.

[G.K.I., J.] & [R.
